purpose: Regression contract linking SysML design requirements to pytest verification cases.

requirements.title: Roth conversions start at retirement
requirements.statement: The projection shall not perform Roth conversions before the household retirement age, even when the configured conversion window starts earlier.

requirements.title: Roth conversions end at configured conversion end age
requirements.statement: The projection shall set Roth conversions to zero after the configured conversion end age.

requirements.title: Available spending formula is conserved
requirements.statement: Available spending after taxes shall equal total income plus withdrawals less total taxes, property tax, and net ACA premiums, floored at zero.

requirements.title: Maryland remains the relocation baseline
requirements.statement: Relocation comparison shall calculate additional dollars per year against Maryland and report Maryland as zero versus itself.

requirements.title: Relocation states are limited to modeled tax data
requirements.statement: Relocation comparison shall only use states with available state tax data files in the analysis dataset.

requirements.title: Dynamic optimizer produces schedule and heat map
requirements.statement: Dynamic Roth conversion optimization shall return a selected annual schedule and a candidate heat map bounded by the retirement and conversion window.

requirements.title: After-tax estate value is an optimization objective
requirements.statement: Strategy comparison shall calculate after-tax estate value as ending estate value less estimated federal and state estate taxes.

requirements.title: RMD forecast is present in annual projection
requirements.statement: Annual projection shall report required minimum distribution values by age so conversion decisions can account for future RMD exposure.
